name: CNC Mill Overheating
description: A critical CNC mill is showing signs of overheating. This typically leads to micro-fractures and tolerance errors in the parts it produces.
initial_impact: Parts from CNC Mill #3 will have a 15% higher defect rate.

cascading_effects.effect: Quality score will begin to drop due to faulty parts from the CNC Mill.
cascading_effects.impact_description: A 15-minute delay occurs as defective parts travel from the mill to the assembly line.

cascading_effects.effect: Overall plant yield will decrease as more final products are rejected.
cascading_effects.impact_description: It takes 45 minutes for the defective assembled parts to reach final QC.
